summary: All 16 members of The Enclave gathered around Ryn and Elara's hearth on Sol 3 to break warm iron-wheat bread, debate magnetohydrodynamic kelvin-helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea, and release the day's magnetospheric tension.
science_vegetable: Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea
narrative_prose: The Hub Hearth glowed with amber resilience as all sixteen members of The Enclave converged around the long timber tables at the close of Sol 3. Outside the insulated bulkheads, the magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea sent low harmonic tremors through the deck plating, while inside the aroma of braised root vegetables and warm iron-wheat bread steadied frayed nerves. Ryn adjusted the induction dampers to DEFEND the simmering copper stockpot from erratic magnetic eddies, letting the savory steam ATTRACT the returning ridge scouts toward the bench. With a practiced nod, she ladled a generous portion into a heavy ceramic bowl and passed the steaming vessel directly into Silas's hands so the crew could CONSUME the evening meal together.
